# 👋 Welcome

I’m **Gustavo Roa**, a Postdoctoral Researcher in Agronomy at Kansas State University, specializing in soil fertility, nutrient management, and nutrient use efficiency. My work combines field and greenhouse research to understand crop responses to fertilizer and improve nutrient management. I also mentor students and help coordinate research projects.

With an M.S. in Statistics, I connect agricultural research with data analysis and statistical methods. I provide statistical consulting, supporting researchers with experimental design, data analysis, and interpretation of results. I also explore applications of artificial intelligence to research and data analysis.
